# rocket v0.2.4 - Table of Contents

High-performance HTTP/1.1 server for the BEAM using OTP 28 :socket and a picohttpparser NIF.

## Pages

- [Rocket](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Rocket](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.md): High-performance HTTP/1.1 server for the BEAM.
- [Rocket.Acceptor](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.Acceptor.md): Accept loop process. Calls `:socket.accept/1` in a tight loop,
hands off each connection to a new `Rocket.Connection` process.
- [Rocket.Connection](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.Connection.md): Per-connection process. Owns one client socket for its lifetime.
- [Rocket.EchoHandler](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.EchoHandler.md): Echo handler for testing. Demonstrates the Router DSL.

- [Rocket.HTTP](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.HTTP.md): NIF-based HTTP/1.1 parser powered by picohttpparser.
- [Rocket.Handler](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.Handler.md): Behaviour for Rocket request handlers.

- [Rocket.Listener](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.Listener.md): Opens a TCP listening socket and spawns an acceptor pool.
- [Rocket.Request](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.Request.md): HTTP request struct built from NIF-parsed data.

- [Rocket.Response](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.Response.md): Response helpers for Rocket handlers.

- [Rocket.Router](https://rocket.hexdocs.pm/Rocket.Router.md): Macro-based router that compiles routes to pattern-match clauses.
